name: FAMILY 10 - Weekly Family Update Command -> Gmail

parameters.content:
## TODO before enabling
1. Add credential to **Telegram Trigger** + **Telegram Ack** (`telegram_bot_main`)
2. Add credential to **Gmail Send Family Update** (`gmail_rb4family_oauth`)
3. Command format: `/familyweekly <toEmail> <weekLabel>`
4. Replace template sections in `Build Weekly Email`
5. Activate after dry-run to your own email
